verses.text: Tzeyil wal he b'a, talaj ay junok mach sk'e wa'an t'a he kal schekab' Dios yalani, tz'och ijan yalani to ay tas ma wayich syila', ma sch'oxanel t'a he kal tastak to satub'tak yilji, ma ayokto syalan yuj junok tas ol ujok,
tato k'okb'il tz'elk'och tas syal chi' tz'och ijan yalan t'ayex icha tik: Kotanhek, ay wal juntzanhxo Dios manh eyojtakok, b'at onh emek kuman t'a yichanh, tzonh ochek ejmelal t'ay, tato xchi t'ayex,
manh he cha eyab' juntzanh chi' t'ay. Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal, snib'ej syila' tato yel tze xajanej yet' smasanil he k'o'ol yet' smasanil he pensar.
Ochanhek tzak'an t'a spatik Jehová ko Diosal, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat, k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il, ab'ek tas syala', ochanhek ejmelal t'ay, junnhejokab' heyaj yet'ok.

Ha jun anima syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', mato syala' to ay tas syila', yowalil schami, yujto snib'ej tzex elkan t'a spatik Jehová. Snib'ej jun anima chi' tzex skuchb'ej yik tze pitej he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal onh kolanelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ek'nak onh chekab'wumal. Yuj chi' tze mak'cham jun anima chi', yik wach' satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.

Tato ay mach tzex kuchb'anb'at t'a elk'altak eyoch ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb' anima kajan t'a he lak'anil, ma t'a najat, haton juntzanh b'aj max kal ko b'a, manh yalnakokpax sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, manh he cha eyab' t'ay. Hak'ekoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal yik schami. Mokab' ok' he k'ol t'ay, wach'chom eyuk'tak, ma eyuninal, ma eyisil, ma eyetb'eyum to xajanab'il eyu'uj, ma a junok te wach' eyak'an yet'ok, manh he k'ub'ejeli. Ha ex tze b'ab'laj ik'ejk'e k'e'en k'e'en tze julanchamok. Icha pax chi' syutej masanil heb' anima heyet'ok. Julk'enajokab' chamok, yujto snib'ej tzex yik'el t'a spatik Jehová ko Diosal onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ek'nak onh chekab'wumal. Ol yab' jun chi' heb' ketchonhab' smasanil, ol xiw heb', manhxo ol say mulan sb'a heb' icha juntzanh ix uji chi'.
Tato ha t'a junok juntzanh chonhab' wan yak'an Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex yik tzex kajnaj t'ay, tzeyab' spekal to
ay heb' max k'anab'ajan Dios, haxo heb' skuchb'an sk'ulok heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' chi' yoch ejmelal t'a komon Dios b'aj max kal ko b'a,
scham wal he k'anb'anek' eyab'i. Tato yel ay mach wan sk'ulan jun chukal chi' t'a he kal,
a masanil heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi', xikjicham heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok', tze satanel masanil tastak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Ha b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima, hata' tze molb'ejoch masanil stastak heb', tzeyak'anoch sk'ak'al jun chonhab' chi' yet' masanil stastak heb' chi' silab'ok yuj eyik'ancha'anh Jehová ko Diosal. Ha jun chonhab' chi', skanxonhej icha chi'. Manhxa b'ak'inh sb'ojixik'ei.

Ha juntzanh tastak toxo ix alchaji to sateli, manh eyama', yik wach' max kot yowal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex. Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan t'ayex tik, wach' tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová, ol yak' swach'k'olal t'ayex, ol yak'an k'ib' he b'isul icha ajnak yak'ankan sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
